scope: K1–K7 synthetic controls observation implementation and frozen gate facts. K8 acceptance is recorded separately in controls-ui-review.json. This is not complete V2, B01–B13 persistent/runtime service acceptance, deployment or actual AT.

commands.name: design-validator
command:
import pathlib, tempfile, shutil, subprocess
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="ifpmic-gate-") as temp:
 target=pathlib.Path(temp)/"design"
 shutil.copytree("docs/ifpmic/design-v1",target)
 subprocess.run(["python3",str(target/"verify_design.py")],check=True)

main_visual_review.scope: Actual PNG sampling covers all twelve required capture cases across both environments. Automated geometry/state checks cover all 164 control captures. Not every PNG was manually read.
main_visual_review.finding: Sampled target groups are readable with no visible clipping or host overlay. Command receipt, workflow state, control phase, late patch/receipt and device reconciliation are distinguished.

verification_scope_notes: K4 valid positive anchors and per-field null/missing/extra tests supplement strict-shape tests; malformed rejections also preserve command receipts.
Performance records counts and fixture hashes for six fixed candidate traces, with exact prior59 bytes independently pinned by catalog tests. It is not a load/durability/real hardware benchmark.
No runtime phase/retry/bridge/remote policy change was needed in this increment. UI renders allowlisted scalar mock evidence and issues no control API writes.
Original acceptance-cases.json remains unchanged with all32 cases not_executed.

Plan K6 selects PNG checkpoint/viewport combinations; other checkpoints are covered by independent unit and browser state checks. K0–K8 are not skipped; K8 independent verdict is a separate evidence file.

assembly_diagnostics.finding: An initial archive-verifier assertion expected fullyVisible/points metadata, but control captures use compact rect/hit_grid/overflow_clipping_ancestors keys. It stopped before writing any archive.
assembly_diagnostics.resolution: Revalidated exact bounding boxes, all16 target hits, zero overlaps and all clipping ancestors using the actual recorded schema. Gate results were not changed.
